summary: Completed frontend-only timeline regression on public preview URL. Desktop timeline behavior largely matches requirements when positioned at runway start, but mobile has a critical timeline state desynchronization near runway end causing incorrect card/counter and boundary control state.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390px mobile at runway end, left panel shows year 2025 while right card remains at 2021 with counter 15/19; next button is not disabled at end boundary.

integration_issues.issue: Programmatic/fast scroll to runway end can produce inconsistent active state between image/year panel and season stats card on mobile.

action_items: Fix timeline state synchronization so left visual year/image and right season card/counter always represent the same active year, especially under mobile end-of-runway scrolling.
Ensure next/previous control disabled states are derived from the same synchronized active index and reliably reflect boundaries (2007 and 2025) on mobile.
Retest mobile 390px with slow and fast scroll patterns to verify no desync across all years.
critical_code_review_comments: SeasonTimeline keydown effect has no dependency array, causing listener rebind on every render; this can add unnecessary churn under frequent scroll-driven re-renders.

Scroll progress updates and animated card transitions appear to permit transient/persistent UI mismatch under mobile conditions; state updates should be centralized or transition-guarded to prevent split render states.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use runway absolute start/end positioning for deterministic checks. Desktop passes: single card, start=2007, button+keyboard +/-1 year, sticky top=0, no horizontal overflow, end=2025 with disabled next on recheck. Mobile fails at end-state sync: left year/image reached 2025 while right card/counter stayed at 2021/15 of 19 and next button remained enabled.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: set viewport to 390x844, scroll to timeline runway end, wait ~2.2s, inspect [data-testid='timeline-active-year'], .season-single-card data-testid/year text, timeline counter, and next button disabled state. Observed mismatch: left year=2025 with Ferrari image, while card shows season-card-2021 and counter 15/19; next button remains enabled. Probable root cause: active state updates from scroll progress and animated card transition lifecycle can diverge under mobile/lenis scrolling timing, leaving controls/card on stale index while visual year/image reflects later index. Mitigation: unify rendered sources of truth for year, card, counter, and controls from a single synchronized index and guard transition timing so stale exiting content cannot present as current state.
